title: Pickup ETA via a maps routing adapter
name: Pickup ETA adapter

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this adapter calls the maps provider and translates its responses and failures? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
With maxAttempts = 3, the provider returns HTTP 400 on the first call. What does estimate() do?
choices: Retries twice with backoff, then throws RoutingUnavailableError
Returns an estimate with trafficAware = false

questions.prompt: The provider is fully down (every call times out). What does a rider see from PickupEtaService?
choices: An error, because the adapter's errors propagate to the caller
A provider ETA from a cached previous response
A fallback ETA computed from straight-line distance, after the adapter exhausts its attempts
A fallback ETA computed on the first timeout, without further attempts

questions.prompt: A two-leg route returns duration_in_traffic on the first leg only. What is reported?
choices: Traffic duration of leg 1 plus plain duration of leg 2, with trafficAware = false
Only the plain durations of both legs, with trafficAware = false
Traffic duration of leg 1 plus plain duration of leg 2, with trafficAware = true
Only leg 1's traffic duration, since leg 2 lacks traffic data
